Articulate is an AI speaking partner. You practice spoken English out loud, an AI partner asks you short questions to keep you talking, and you get feedback on your speaking pace, filler words and pauses after every session.
Yes. You can start free with practice minutes every month. Paid plans start at ₹99 a month for 600 practice minutes.
Do I need good English to start?
No. Articulate is made for beginners too. Questions use simple, everyday English, and you can choose your speaking level.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes. Articulate works in your phone browser on Android and iPhone, and on computers. All you need is a microphone and an internet connection.
How is my voice data used?
Your voice is turned into text so your AI partner can reply and give feedback. Audio is not stored on our servers after transcription, and we never sell your data.
What is the difference between the ₹99 and ₹249 plans?
Both give 600 practice minutes a month. In the ₹99 plan your AI partner's questions appear on screen. In the ₹249 plan your AI partner also talks with you out loud, like a real conversation.
